frequency_question: How often does major permitting or regulatory overhaul legislation pass within a designated multi-year congressional session window?
membership_rule: Includes major omnibus bills explicitly targeting cross-sector energy, transport, or environmental permitting reform; excludes standard annual appropriations, minor technical corrections, or standalone single-agency authorizations.

cases.name: 110th Congress Energy Independence and Security Act
112th Congress Pipeline Safety, Regulatory Relief, and Job Creation Act
117th Congress Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (permitting elements)
118th Congress Fiscal Responsibility Act (NEPA permitting reform elements)

coverage_note: 7 major legislative vehicles examined across recent congressional cycles; 4 achieved substantive permitting/infrastructure approval reforms.
known_gaps: Excludes minor rider attachments inside larger omnibus spending packages that did not receive standalone framing.
validity_reason: Base rate reflects long-term congressional gridlock dynamics and institutional appetite for compromise on infrastructure, which evolve slowly over multi-decade horizons.
